text:
IncidentBot: PAGE: high 5xx spike - ALB targetgroup health ping failures in euc1-azb. Pager duty: maya_oncall
maya_oncall: saw alerts - checking grafana now
alex_sre: I'm on it - loading ELB logs, looks like connection resets from envoy on pods behind ingress
maya_oncall: customer-facing 5xx rate ~18% on /api/v1/generate, errors spike started 01:04 UTC
sam_platform: is this limited to euc1-azb? any cross-region traffic affected?
alex_sre: initial look: ALB -> NLB -> Envoy upstream showing TLS handshake timeouts. NLB target health flapping for workers in azb
zhen_engineer: I can try draining and re-registering targets in that AZ, will coordinate w/ infra
maya_oncall: please coordinate, notify sales/cs for impacted customers
opsbot: deploy 1798 promoted to euc1-azc earlier, not related per logs
alex_sre: mitigation plan: a) mark azb targets OutOfService on ALB to failover to other AZs b) increase envoy upstream retries c) enable fallback model routing to dedicated pool
maya_oncall: do (a) now, alex? I can handle (b) and (c)
alex_sre: doing ALB target deregister now:
```
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:...:targetgroup/tg-euc1-azb --targets Id=i-0abcd1234
```
alex_sre: deregistered 12 targets from azb, expected to shift traffic in ~30s
maya_oncall: seeing 5xx drop to ~3% after failover, p95 latency improving
sam_platform: filing an incident ticket and tagging cs-oncall. Recommended customer impact: partial (some customers in EU region experienced errors ~01:04-01:18 UTC)
maya_oncall: handoff to alex for postmortem and RCA, I'll stay for next 15m overlap
alex_sre: noted. I'll collect ELB/NLB/Envoy traces, save configs, and open postmortem draft. Suspect networking vendor flaps in azb causing connection resets to upstream instances.
zhen_engineer: re-registered healthy targets after manual health check, but will keep them OOS until we validate networking stability
maya_oncall: notify customers: short message to CS: "We've mitigated an ALB/ingress outage in euc1-azb that caused elevated 5xx rates for some regional traffic. Failover completed; we're investigating root cause and will follow up." :thumbsup:
alex_sre: creating postmortem ticket: PM-179999 - collecting artifacts (ELB logs, envoy logs, kube events, host network stats)
opsbot: created incident PM-179999 and attached automated trace links
maya_oncall: closing pager for now; monitoring 10m. If 5xx >5% reopen.
IncidentBot: Incident acknowledged by maya_oncall
